document:0:122:0.text:
Begin by adding His Lordship's favorite <style="highlight">snowmelt leaves</style>.
Then, delicately place <style="highlight">dried petals</style> within.
Conclude by pouring <style="highlight">hot water</style> into the teapot.
When the rising steam softens to but a single elegant wisp, the tea is ready to grace your palate.
document:0:122:0.source_cn:
首先，加入子爵先生最爱的<style="highlight">寒泉茶叶</style>
其次，加入<style="highlight">晾干的花瓣</style>
最后，将<style="highlight">热水</style>倒入茶壶
当壶嘴冒出的雾气减少至只剩一缕，就是品尝的最佳温度

say:9:1321010001:1.text: Uh-huh, you're doing exactly right. That's how tea is made!
say:9:1321010001:1.source_cn: 没错，按照这个步骤，一壶新茶就泡好了。

say:10:1321010002:1.text: But it tastes exactly the same—no fragrance, just bitterness. This is very odd!

choice_prompt:11:1321010002.text: But it tastes exactly the same—no fragrance, just bitterness. This is very odd!
choice_prompt:11:1321010002.source_cn: 但这壶新茶的味道和之前那壶一样，完全没有从前的清香，只有苦涩。这真是太奇怪了！

say:12:1321010003:0.text: Every step you took was perfect, and the teapot is fine too...
say:12:1321010003:0.source_cn: 是的，您的每个操作都非常完美。茶具也没有问题……
say:12:1321010003:0.male: Every step you took was perfect, and the teapot is fine too...
say:12:1321010003:0.female: Every step you took was perfect, and the teapot is fine too...

say:13:1321010004:1.text: Could it be the tea leaves?
say:13:1321010004:1.source_cn: 难道真的是茶叶出了问题……？
say:13:1321010004:1.male: Could it be the tea leaves?
say:13:1321010004:1.female: Could it be the tea leaves?

say:14:1321010005:1.text: The tea leaves I picked should be alright...
say:14:1321010005:1.source_cn: 茶叶，是我采摘的。不应该有问题……

say:15:1321010006:1.text: Especially since I used the ones that he picked just a couple of days ago... They should be fine.
say:15:1321010006:1.source_cn: 没错，尤其我今天用的还是前两天奇花刚刚采摘回来的。

say:17:1321010008:1.text: I must find out why this tea is bitter. I can't let His Lordship drink this!
say:17:1321010008:1.source_cn: 是的。所以我必须尽快找出这壶茶变苦的原因，不能让子爵先...

say:18:1321010009:1.text: Please excuse me for a moment, dear guests. I'll brew another pot with the tea His Lordship usually drinks.
say:18:1321010009:1.source_cn: 各位客人，请允许我暂时失陪一下，用平日子爵先生常喝的茶...

narration:19:1321010010:1.text: Mister Teapot brews another pot with his usual tea leaves...

say:20:1321010011:1.text: Ah, finally! No bitterness in this tea. It looks like the issue really was the tea leaves.
say:20:1321010011:1.source_cn: 唔，这次的茶终于没有苦味了，看来真的是茶叶的问题！

say:23:1321010012:1.text: But the petals and tea leaves were hand-picked by Mister Flower... How could they be bitter?
say:23:1321010012:1.source_cn: 那就奇怪了，之前那些茶叶不是奇花侍者采回来的花瓣吗？怎...

say:25:1321010014:1.text: What do you have to say now, huh?
say:25:1321010014:1.source_cn: ……奇花，你想说什么？为什么不继续说下去了？

say:26:1321010015:1.text: Now that I think about it, not only did you harvest those petals, but it was also your idea to add them to tea leaves. His Lordship even praised you for that.
say:26:1321010015:1.source_cn: 仔细想一想，不仅这些花瓣是你采回来的，再往前，用花瓣当...

say:27:1321010016:1.text: Has His Lordship's favor gone to your head? Do you think you can replace me now?
say:27:1321010016:1.source_cn: 难道是先生的恩宠宠坏了你，冲昏了你的头脑，让你以为自己...

say:28:1321010017:1.text: Wait, Mister Teapot, are you accusing Mister Flower?
say:28:1321010017:1.source_cn: ……诶？茶壶先生，你这是在指责奇花吗？

say:30:1321010019:1.text: Please forgive my rudeness. But as someone who has been with His Lordship the longest, I need to get to the bottom of this.
say:30:1321010019:1.source_cn: 抱歉，客人们，请原谅我的失礼。但作为陪伴子爵先生最久的...

say:31:1321010020:1.text: These petals and tea leaves were harvested by Mister Flower. Besides him and me, no one else had access to them, so there's no chance anyone else could've tampered with them.
say:31:1321010020:1.source_cn: 这些花瓣是奇花亲手采回来的，除了我和他以外，没有其他人...

say:32:1321010021:1.text: Mister Flower, could you explain why you always linger near the tea storage area after you return from picking leaves?
say:32:1321010021:1.source_cn: 奇花，你每次采花回来，都会在储存茶叶的橱柜附近徘徊很久...

say:34:1321010023:1.text: Were you trying to get me in trouble with His Lordship by making me mess up the tea?
say:34:1321010023:1.source_cn: 你是不是不满我对你的教导，所以想要害我犯错，被子爵先生责罚？

say:39:1321010026:1.text: Wait, Mister Flower! Don't just run away!

say:43:1321010028:1.text: Mister Teapot, you can't just accuse Mister Flower without any proof!
say:43:1321010028:1.source_cn: 茶壶先生！你太过分了，明明什么证据都没有，怎么能这样指...

say:44:1321010029:1.text: I-I didn't expect him to run off. I just wanted to figure out what happened...
say:44:1321010029:1.source_cn: 我……我没想到奇花会直接跑开。我只是想问清楚究竟是怎么...
